title: PANC: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2602.06912v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study training-free in-context segmentation with externally annotated context priors: given a target image and a small set of foreground/background tokens extracted from annotated context images, the goal is to segment the corresponding target concept without training, fine-tuning, or target-image clicks. Existing ViT-token spectral methods such as TokenCut are class-agnostic and can select the wrong object in multi-object scenes, or become unstable in low-semantic texture-dominated domains. We propose PANC, a prior-aware spectral segmentation pipeline that injects external labeled tokens into a frozen ViT affinity graph through two foreground/background anchor nodes. The anchors do not clamp target-image tokens; instead, they softly bias the Normalized Cut eigenspace while preserving the target-image affinity structure. translated_title: PANC：面向免训练上下文分割的先验感知归一化切割方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了利用外部标注上下文先验的免训练上下文分割任务：给定一张目标图像和一小部分从已标注上下文图像中提取的前景/背景标记，目标是在无需训练、微调或点击目标图像的情况下分割出对应的目标概念。现有的ViT标记谱方法（如TokenCut）是类别无关的，在多目标场景中可能选中错误的对象，或者在低语义、纹理主导的领域中变得不稳定。我们提出了PANC，这是一种先验感知的谱分割流水线，通过两个前景/背景锚节点将外部标注的标记注入到冻结的ViT亲和图中。这些锚节点并不强制约束目标图像的标记，而是柔和地偏置归一化切割的特征空间，同时保留目标图像的亲和结构。PANC还进一步利用先验感知的符号稳定和先验驱动的阈值化来获得确定性的掩码……
tldr: PANC通过在冻结ViT亲和图中引入前景/背景锚节点来柔性地偏置归一化切割特征空间，实现了一种利用外部标注先验、无需训练的上下文分割方法，解决了多目标场景中误选对象以及纹理主导领域中不稳定的问题。
en_tdlr: PANC injects foreground/background anchor nodes into a frozen ViT affinity graph to softly bias the Normalized Cut eigenspace, enabling training-free in-context segmentation with annotated priors that avoids selecting wrong objects in multi-object scenes and remains stable in texture-dominated domains.
